title: Copy timestamp from one file to another
summary: Use touch with the -r option to set a file's timestamp to match that of a reference file. This is helpful for synchronizing file dates without changing their content.

steps.explain: Use the -r option to specify the reference file whose timestamp you want to copy. Add -c to avoid creating the target file if it doesn't exist.

placeholders.name: REFERENCE_FILE
placeholders.description: The file whose timestamp to copy
